modules.name: Web Panel
modules.description: Administrative web interface for project setup, Society Manager creation, complaint control, family and member dashboard, notices, events, contact directory, reports and activity log.

modules.name: Mobile App
modules.description: A single role-based mobile app for residents, managers and watchmen covering login, registration, complaints, documents, bookings, visitors, family, notices and event replies.

requirements.title: Web Panel project, building and flat setup
requirements.description: The Web Panel must support setup of projects, buildings and flats.

requirements.title: Society Manager creation
requirements.description: The Web Panel must allow Society Managers to be created.

requirements.title: Complaint control in Web Panel
requirements.description: The Web Panel must provide control over complaints.

requirements.title: Family and member dashboard
requirements.description: The Web Panel must include a family and member dashboard.

requirements.title: Notice board and event invites in Web Panel
requirements.description: The Web Panel must support a notice board and event invites.

requirements.title: Contact directory in Web Panel
requirements.description: The Web Panel must include a contact directory.

requirements.title: Reports and activity log
requirements.description: The Web Panel must provide reports and an activity log.

requirements.title: OTP login on mobile app
requirements.description: The Mobile App must support login using OTP.

requirements.title: Self-registration with approval
requirements.description: The Mobile App must allow users to self-register, with the registration subject to approval.

requirements.title: Complaints on mobile app
requirements.description: The Mobile App must support complaints.

requirements.title: Contact directory and society documents on mobile app
requirements.description: The Mobile App must provide a contact directory and access to society documents.

requirements.title: Hall booking and facility use
requirements.description: The Mobile App must support hall booking and facility use.

requirements.title: Visitors and Watchman view
requirements.description: The Mobile App must support visitors and include a Watchman view.

requirements.title: My Family
requirements.description: The Mobile App must include a My Family feature.

requirements.title: Notice board and event replies on mobile app
requirements.description: The Mobile App must show the notice board and let users reply to events.

requirements.title: Single role-based mobile app
requirements.description: There must be one mobile app serving all roles, with features based on role.

requirements.title: One common backend for all projects
requirements.description: The system must use one common backend for all projects.

requirements.title: Integration with SMS provider, push service and file storage
requirements.description: The system must connect with an SMS provider for OTP, a push notification service, and file storage for photos and documents.

rules.title: Phase 1 scope limited to 57 features
rules.description: Phase 1 covers the 57 features in Section 5; billing, accounting and payments stay out.

rules.title: Access by role and project
rules.description: Access to the system is based on the user's role and project.

rules.title: Out of scope: bill collection, payments and accounting
rules.description: Maintenance bill collection and payments, and society accounting, are not part of this system.

rules.title: No contact with Raghuvir sales, booking or accounting systems
rules.description: The system must not touch Raghuvir's sales, booking or accounting systems.
